Hyundai Bayon on‑road price in Shillong ranges from ₹11.05 lakh to ₹20.70 lakh

Hyundai Bayon price in Shillong (October 2026)

Hyundai’s sub‑compact SUV Bayon – launched in India in October 2023 – is now listed with on‑road prices for the city of Shillong. The figures come from Hyundai’s official price‑listing tool and reflect the cost after registration, road tax and insurance.

Variant‑wise on‑road pricing (Shillong)

  • HX2 MT – 6‑speed manual, 16‑inch steel wheels with covers – ₹11.05 lakh
  • HX6 iVT – 6‑speed Intelligent Variable Transmission, 17‑inch styled steel wheels – ₹16.77 lakh
  • HX10 Dual‑tone iVT – iVT, 17‑inch diamond‑cut alloy wheels, premium equipment – ₹20.70 lakh

Note: Prices are *estimated on‑road* and may vary slightly with changes in registration fees, road tax or insurance rates.

The EMI numbers are quoted by the source as examples; actual loan terms will depend on the lender’s interest rate and tenure.

Feature ladder across the three trims

  • Transmission – Manual (HX2) vs. iVT automatic (HX6, HX10)
  • Wheels – 16‑inch steel (HX2) → 17‑inch styled steel (HX6) → 17‑inch diamond‑cut alloy (HX10)
  • Comfort – Ventilated front seats, 8‑way electric driver seat and wireless charger appear from HX6 upwards.
  • Premium touches – Panoramic sunroof, Bose premium sound system and extended Bluelink connectivity are exclusive to HX10.
  • Safety suite – Hyundai SmartSense ADAS Level 2 Pro, Surround‑View Monitor and Blind‑Spot View Monitor are standard on the top trim; lower trims receive basic airbags and ABS.

Powertrain and mileage – not announced for Shillong pricing

The source does not provide engine displacement, power output, fuel‑type or official mileage figures for the Shillong variants. Prospective buyers should refer to Hyundai’s national specification sheet (1.2‑litre naturally aspirated petrol engine, 84 PS, CVT or iVT) for a baseline, but verify the exact configuration offered in Shillong with the dealer.

Practical implications for buyers

  • Budget comparison – At ₹11.05 lakh the base HX2 MT competes with the Maruti Suzuki Brezza and Kia Sonet entry‑levels, while the top HX10 iVT sits against the Tata Nexon XZ+ and Hyundai Creta’s mid‑range trims.
  • Feature prioritisation – Buyers who value a sunroof, premium audio and advanced ADAS should target the HX10; those satisfied with basic comfort can save over ₹5 lakh by opting for HX2.
  • Financing – The EMI examples show how a higher‑priced trim roughly doubles the monthly outlay. Customers should obtain a personalized quote from their bank before signing.

How to verify the numbers

  1. Visit the official Hyundai India price calculator (hyundai.com/in/price‑calculator) and select *Shillong* as the city.
  2. Contact any authorised Hyundai dealer in Shillong – the website lists three showrooms with phone numbers.
  3. Request a printed on‑road quotation that itemises registration, road tax, insurance and any dealer discounts.

Availability

All three Bayon variants are listed as available for immediate delivery in Shillong, subject to dealer stock. Hyundai has not announced any limited‑edition or region‑specific models for the city.
